title: GetCertificationResponse
description: Response body for retrieving certification details including KYC status and business information.

status.title: status
status.description: The status of the certification. Allowed values PENDING_SAVED, PENDING_SUBMITTED, APPROVED, DECLINED, RFI_PENDING.

product_code.title: product_code
product_code.description: Product code. Currently supports PAYMENT_CORE and ACQ_ONLINE.

Account-Usage.title: account_usage
Account-Usage.description: Description of merchant's business purpose of using PSP account. Required for CN and HK.

Birth-Details.title: BirthDetails
Birth-Details.description: Birth information of the business person.

date.title: date
date.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), birth_date is required for CN and HK.

Business.title: Business
Business.description: Detailed information of the business for certification.

allOf.description: The full legal name of the business in English. Required for CN and HK.

name_in_local_language.title: name_in_local_language
name_in_local_language.description: The full legal name of the business in the local language. Required for CN and HK.

establishment_date.title: establishment_date
establishment_date.description: Company establishment date. Required for CN and HK.

license_expiry_date.title: license_expiry_date
license_expiry_date.description: Expiry date of company license; format yyyy-mm-dd. Fill in 9999-12-31 for a long-term license. Required for CN. For HK, this is expiry date of business registration.

products_and_services_category.title: products_and_services_category
products_and_services_category.description: Products and services category. Required for CN and HK.

account_usage.title: account_usage
account_usage.description: List of account usage. Required for CN and HK.

description.title: description
description.description: Description of the business. This is one of the three ways of proving the business.

website.title: website
website.description: Website URL. This is one of the three ways of proving the business.

business_proof_file_id.title: business_proof_file_id
business_proof_file_id.description: File ID for a screenshot of the business website/dashboards.

street_name.title: street_name
street_name.description: Street name. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

postal_code.title: postal_code
postal_code.description: Postal code or ZIP code. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

city.title: city
city.description: City name. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

district.title: district
district.description: District name. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

state.title: state
state.description: State or province name. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

Business-Person.title: BusinessPerson
Business-Person.description: Business person details for KYC certification.

role.title: role
role.description:
Role of business person. Required for both CHINA and HONGKONG.
UBO, DIRECTOR_CONTROL_PERSON_OR_LEGAL_REP, AGENT_OR_AUTHORISED_PERSON are applicable for CHINA.
UBO, DIRECTOR_CONTROL_PERSON_OR_LEGAL_REP, AGENT_OR_AUTHORISED_PERSON are applicable for HONGKONG.
For the limitation on the number of business persons-
UBO - 4 maximum across all regions (as UBO is defined as shareholding above 25%).
Legal rep/Director - 1 for CN (only one legal rep per CN law) and up to 25 directors for HK.
Agent - 1, as there can only be 1 agent.

nationality.title: nationality
nationality.description: Business person's nationality. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

country_code.title: country_code
country_code.description: Country code. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

merchant_ack.title: merchant_ack
merchant_ack.description: Has the merchant signed the payment service provider service terms? YES or NO.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Document information for KYC validation including document type, sub-type, and file reference.

type.title: type
type.description:
Type of identity document (ID).
certificate_of_registration is applicable for CHINA.
certificate_of_incorporation and business_registration are applicable for HONGKONG.

sub_type.title: sub_type
sub_type.description: Applicable only if the type is certificate_of_registration.

number.title: number
number.description:
Document ID number.
required if type is certificate_of_registration for CHINA.
required if type are certificate_of_incorporation and business_registration for HONGKONG.

File-Id.description: Unique identifier for the document uploaded.
File-Id.title: file_id

Person-Document.title: PersonDocument
Person-Document.description: Document information for business person KYC validation.

type.title: type
type.description:
Type of identity document (ID). Provide details for one primary identity document (CHINESE_RESIDENT_IDENTITY_CARD, NATIONAL_OR_STATE_ID, PASSPORT, DRIVERS_LICENSE, RESIDENCE_PERMIT, TAX_ID, PROOF_OF_AGE_CARD, MY_NUMBER_CARD, MAINLAND_TRAVEL_PERMIT), optionally supplemented by AUTHORISED_LETTER, PROOF_OF_ADDRESS, or HAND_HOLD_PHOTO if required.
AUTHORISED_LETTER is required if the role is AUTHORISED_PERSON
NATIONAL_OR_STATE_ID, PASSPORT, RESIDENCE_PERMIT, MAINLAND_TRAVEL_PERMIT are applicable for CHINA.
NATIONAL_OR_STATE_ID, PASSPORT, RESIDENCE_PERMIT, CHINESE_RESIDENT_IDENTITY_CARD, MAINLAND_TRAVEL_PERMIT are applicable for HONGHONG.

sub_type.title: sub_type
sub_type.description: Applicable for all id type other than PASSPORT. Front and Back both sub_type is applicable for CN and HK. When BACK is used, number, expiry_date, issue_date, issuing_authority are not required.

number.title: number
number.description: Document ID number. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

expiry_date.title: expiry_date
expiry_date.description: The expiry date of the ID document; format yyyy-mm-dd. Fill in 9999-12-31 if there is no expiry date. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

issue_date.title: issue_date
issue_date.description: Issuing date of the ID document; format yyyy-mm-dd. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

issuing_authority.title: issuing_authority
issuing_authority.description: Issuing authority of merchant's identity document. Required for CHINA and HONGKONG.

Personal-Details.title: Personal-Details
Personal-Details.description: This section contains the name details.

first_name.title: first_name
first_name.description: Business person's first name in English. Required for CN and HK.

first_name_in_local_language.title: first_name_in_local_language
first_name_in_local_language.description: Business person's first name in local language. Required for CN and HK.

middle_name.title: middle_name
middle_name.description: Business person's middle name in English. Optional for CN and HK.

middle_name_in_local_language.title: middle_name_in_local_language
middle_name_in_local_language.description: Business person's middle name in local language. Optional for CN and HK.

last_name.title: last_name
last_name.description: Business person's last name in English. Required for CN and HK.

last_name_in_local_language.title: last_name_in_local_language
last_name_in_local_language.description: Business person's full name in local language. Required for CN and HK.
